relatedRecordId.title: Related Record ID
relatedRecordId.description: The unique ID of the parent record (typically the 006... Opportunity ID) whose related conversations should be searched.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Free-text query describing the topic, risk, blocker, or theme to search for across conversation transcripts.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Optional start of the date range to search. If omitted, searches the default recent window.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Optional end of the date range to search. If omitted, searches up to today.
